# youtrack_issue_link_type (Resource)

Manages an issue link type.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "youtrack_issue_link_type" "blocks" {
  name             = "Blocks"
  source_to_target = "blocks"
  target_to_source = "is blocked by"
  directed         = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the link type.
- `source_to_target` (String) Outward name of the link, for example `subtask of`.
- `target_to_source` (String) Inward name of the link, for example `parent for`. Ignored by YouTrack for undirected links.

### Optional

- `aggregation` (Boolean) Whether the link expresses an aggregation, which is used for issue hierarchies.
- `directed` (Boolean) Whether the link is directed.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Database ID of the link type.
